questions.question: What is your main job in the first meeting?
questions.why: Say why you called it, hand the floor over, then listen.
questions.quote: Your job in the first meeting is mostly to listen

questions.question: Agreement comes too fast. What do you ask?
questions.why: Quick agreement can hide doubts; this question surfaces them.
questions.quote: Agreement that comes too fast. Ask, "What would make this fail?"
